heading: High Tide Submission Series: Gi Tournament
venue: Holiday Inn St. John's Conference Centre
intro: High Tide is back with a bigger venue, more mat space for a shorter day, more activities for kids, and the same cash and prizes you've come to love. Every competitor gets a free registration kit.

facts.label: Divisions
facts.text: Kids, teens, and adults, plus an absolute division each for men and women.

facts.label: Prizes
facts.text: $500 cash to the winners of the men's and women's absolute divisions.

facts.label: The day
facts.text: Kids divisions start in the morning and run into the afternoon. Adult divisions run into the afternoon, finishing with the absolutes.

rules: No submission in time? The referee decides.
Absolutes have no time limit and must end in a submission.
fees_note: Fees are per division. The absolute is a separate division, and you must also compete in your regular division to enter it. Organizers may adjust weight classes to keep divisions even.
